notes.title: Chamber's Reunion 1.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello guys![/b][/h1]

I am happy to say that we just released new version of [b]Chamber's Reunion[/b]. There is not much of new content but, still there is some, we added new GUI features, sounds, and short introduction to what happens in the game. So if I was you, I would download the new update and replay this game once again.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 + CHAPTER 2 INFO
notes.content:
[b][h1]CHAPTER ONE[/h1][/b]
Hello, I am happy to say that new update is here, with this update we added few new things..

[b][h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Added new [u]Journal System[/u] to help you navigate in the game
[*] Added a feature to skip the cutscene at the start of the game
[*] Added a UI overhaul (mainly for Journal System)
[/list]

[b][h2]BUGS[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Enemy Chase would not trigger if player didnt look at the enemy
[/list]

[b][h2]DISCORD[/h2][/b]
Also I would like to remind that we have a [url=https://discord.gg/xTa78ZPSKr]Discord[/url] Server, where you can talk about our games, leave feedback and more..

notes.title: BECOMING FREE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players[/b][/h1]

We are here to announce that [b]Chamber's Reunion[/b] will become free. We decided to split this game into [b]3 chapters[/b]. Currently you can play the first chapter for free in the next few days. We are also currently working on the new chapters, and those ones will be paid, we are planning that both chapters should cost about 5-10$

[h2]Q&A[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]What if I purchased the game before going free?[/b] - We take it as support for our little studio, also we are planning on giving those who purchased our game some extra content in some way.
[*] [b]When we will see another chapter?[/b] - We can't say anything yet, but we are working 100% a day, also we are working on some other projects.
[*] [b]Is there a support for another languagues?[/b] - Yes! We currently support: English, Czech. We are also working on other translations such as: Spanish, German, French.
[/olist]

notes.title: Chamber's Reunion Update Is Here
